description: Nahalle Indrasiri Thero v. K. Kumarasiri Nahalle Indrasiri Thero v. K. Kumarasiri View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: Nahalle Indrasiri Thero v. K. Kumarasiri Nahalle Indrasiri Thero v. K. Kumarasiri View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to set aside the District Court order restoring possession of the Respondent in terms of Section 52(2)(b) of the Partition Law; Held - leased property was only bare land and therefore Respondent is not a tenant; learned District Judge directed to make an order for the delivery of possession of land to the Petitioner; Application allowed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
